column1: # Bare figures in vols. 9-12 of the Memoires et correspondance (1824-25). Read from the archive.org page images, 11-12 Nov 2026, by Andrew Beling's agent.
# vol. 9 mmoiresetcorre09morn and vol. 11 mmoiresetcorre11morn: leaf (the n of page/n<leaf>_w1600.jpg) = page + 9, checked on the running head of every page used.
# Found by searching the OCR of both archive.org scans of vols. 9-11 and the one scan of vol. 12 (scripts/find_figures.py), then reading each page image.
# Vols. 10 and 12: no figures found (OCR only; see README). Figures only; the words around them are in v9v12_context.tsv.
# A passage is one unbroken run of figures between words of clear text. Commas printed between figures (R40) are not kept.
# Dates are from the OCR of the letter's date line unless the page image showing it was read (marked in the context file).
